name: Specific time over vague time
rule: Give the exact date or time, with its time zone where it matters, rather than soon or in a few days.

leaders.note: Specific times should carry a time zone, and AM/PM is written uniformly. Date formats are shown and localised. Vague relative terms need a preset select instead of a date picker.
Renewal emails show a real date set in the customer's time zone, falling back to the account zone, then UTC. Reminders are tied to stated lead times, such as 7 days before a trial ends.
